title: A double click on Make Default saves once
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop makes a term of its own the default, and the confirm button gets a quick double click.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-26 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Double-click "Make Default" quickly.
  4. Open the "⋯" page menu.
  5. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 3: the button turns disabled while saving; exactly one toast "{Term-A} is now the default" shows.
  • Step 4: the page menu opens.
  • Step 5: the Credit Terms Log holds exactly one new "Default changed" row, "COD → {Term-A}".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S2-R11: “The confirm button in the Make Default and Delete confirmations is disabled while the change is saving, so a double click saves once.”
  • S12-R3 table, default changed: “The default is changed (Story 2: Row menu actions) | "Default changed" | "{old} → {new}", for example "COD → Net 14"”
